Description:
Enhance your vintage collection or utility display with this unique lot of 3 antique electrical insulators. This set includes a clear Hemingray-56 glass insulator, an amber Whitall Tatum No. 511 glass insulator (both marked Made in U.S.A.), and a brown porcelain insulator of unknown make. Each piece showcases classic industrial designwith embossed brand marks on the glass models and a time-worn patina on the porcelain. Durable and historically significant, these insulators served as essentials in early telegraph and power lines. Perfect for repurposing, educational displays, or collectors, these authentic pieces come from trusted American manufacturers and offer both nostalgia and craftsmanship. Their robust construction ensures longevity for decorative or practical reuse. All pieces are original, showing minor wear consistent with age, adding to their authenticity.

Renowned for their iconic craftsmanship and durability, Hemingray insulators were essential on telephone and telegraph lines in the early-to-mid-20th century. This piece features beautiful embossed branding, a thick glass body, and a delightful beaded rim detail, making it both visually attractive and functional. description:
This lot includes five assorted raw mineral and rock specimens. The set features a purple amethyst, a mostly white quartz, a light yellowish citrine-like stone, and two speckled granite or similar igneous rocks. Each piece is unpolished and irregularly shaped, ranging from approximately 1 to 2 inches in size. All specimens are in natural, unmodified condition with no visible brand or model markings. Suitable for collectors or educational use.

Please contact us with any questions or concerns regarding shipping prior to paying.

Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may not be combined with an unpaid item.

Delivery Not Received:
Please contact within 7 days of the expected delivery date if a package has not been delivered by the time provided by the shipping carrier. We will file a claim with the shipping carrier (typically FedEx) after that. Please do not file a claim before contacting us, FedEx requires the shipper to file them. If the item is returned to us because a signature could not be obtained, or if an item is returned to us as undeliverable/unclaimed it is the buyers responsibility to contact us within 7 days and pay the additional postage to mail it again otherwise items returned to us will be considered a donation and relisted at our discretion.
We are not responsible for packages that were delivered and stolen from property. Goodwill will not be liable and all refund requests will be denied.
Damaged Merchandise:

Description:
Discover the natural beauty and calming energy of this set of four assorted mineral specimens perfect for home decor, meditation, or as a thoughtful gift. This collection includes one polished, clear selenite wand renowned for its luminous surface and reputed cleansing properties. Also included are two sparkling geode halves, each showcasing glittering quartz crystals set within earthy stone matrices. To complete the set, a raw rose quartz chunk adds a warm pink hue and is often associated with love and harmony. Each piece is unique in shape, size, and coloring, offering a truly one-of-a-kind display. These minerals serve as elegant accents for desktops, shelves, or altars, bringing a natural touch and serene ambiance to any room. All specimens are 100% natural and come ready to display. Enjoy the authenticity and timeless appeal of nature's artistry with this hand-selected crystal and mineral set.

description:
Product Overview:
This lot contains a variety of rocks, minerals, and fossils including a multicolored stone marked 'Lee Spiller', a white quartz or calcite geode, clear quartz crystal, agate geodes, chalcedony, quartz clusters, an ammonite fossil, and a trilobite fossil.

Specifications:
- Multicolored stone with inscription
- White geode composed of quartz or calcite
- Clear quartz crystal specimen
- Small mineral specimens including agate geodes, chalcedony, and quartz clusters
- Fossils include ammonite and trilobite
- Natural rough edges and matrix present on some pieces

Additional Information:
The specimens vary in size and form a diverse collection of geological and paleontological samples.

description: This listing includes a collection of natural quartz geode rocks featuring several smaller geode halves and a larger uncut geode. The geodes have a rough tan-to-brown exterior with sparkling quartz crystal interiors ranging from white to slightly yellowish hues. Sizes vary from golf ball-sized or smaller for the halves to roughly baseball-sized for the largest uncut specimen. All pieces are in raw, unpolished condition with visible natural mineral formations and some dirt or earth residue. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or mineral displays.
